Typst is a new markup-based typesetting system that is designed to be as powerful as LaTeX while being much easier to learn and use. Typst has: - Built-in markup for the most common formatting tasks - Flexible functions for everything else - A tightly integrated scripting system - Math typesetting, bibliography management, and more - Fast compile times thanks to incremental compilation - Friendly error messages in case something goes wrong ## Example A [gentle introduction][tutorial] to Typst is available in our documentation. However, if you want to see the power of Typst encapsulated in one image, here it is:

Let's dissect what's going on: - We use _set rules_ to configure element properties like the size of pages or the numbering of headings. By setting the page height to `auto`, it scales to fit the content. Set rules accommodate the most common configurations. If you need full control, you can also use [show rules][show] to completely redefine the appearance of an element. - We insert a heading with the `= Heading` syntax. One equals sign creates a top level heading, two create a subheading and so on. Typst has more lightweight markup like this; see the [syntax] reference for a full list. - [Mathematical equations][math] are enclosed in dollar signs. By adding extra spaces around the contents of an equation, we can put it into a separate block. Multi-letter identifiers are interpreted as Typst definitions and functions unless put into quotes. This way, we don't need backslashes for things like `floor` and `sqrt`. And `phi.alt` applies the `alt` modifier to the `phi` to select a particular symbol variant. - Now, we get to some [scripting]. To input code into a Typst document, we can write a hash followed by an expression. We define two variables and a recursive function to compute the n-th fibonacci number. Then, we display the results in a center-aligned table. The table function takes its cells row-by-row. Therefore, we first pass the formulas `$F_1$` to `$F_8$` and then the computed fibonacci numbers. We apply the spreading operator (`..`) to both because they are arrays and we want to pass the arrays' items as individual arguments.
Text version of the code example. ```typst #set page(width: 10cm, height: auto) #set heading(numbering: "1.") = Fibonacci sequence The Fibonacci sequence is defined through the recurrence relation $F_n = F_(n-1) + F_(n-2)$. It can also be expressed in _closed form:_ $ F_n = round(1 / sqrt(5) phi.alt^n), quad phi.alt = (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2 $ #let count = 8 #let nums = range(1, count + 1) #let fib(n) = ( if n <= 2 { 1 } else { fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2) } ) The first #count numbers of the sequence are: #align(center, table( columns: count, ..nums.map(n => $F_#n$), ..nums.map(n => str(fib(n))), )) ```
## Installation Typst's CLI is available from different sources: - You can get sources and pre-built binaries for the latest release of Typst from the [releases page][releases]. Download the archive for your platform and place it in a directory that is in your `PATH`. To stay up to date with future releases, you can simply run `typst update`. - You can install Typst through different package managers. Note that the versions in the package managers might lag behind the latest release. - Linux: - View [Typst on Repology][repology] - View [Typst's Snap][snap] - macOS: `brew install typst` - Windows: `winget install --id Typst.Typst` ## Usage Once you have installed Typst, you can use it like this: ```sh # Creates `file.pdf` in working directory. typst compile file.typ # Creates a PDF file at the desired path. typst compile path/to/source.typ path/to/output.pdf ``` You can also watch source files and automatically recompile on changes. This is faster than compiling from scratch each time because Typst has incremental compilation. ```sh # Watches source files and recompiles on changes. typst watch file.typ ``` Typst further allows you to add custom font paths for your project and list all of the fonts it discovered: ```sh # Adds additional directories to search for fonts. typst compile --font-path path/to/fonts file.typ # Lists all of the discovered fonts in the system and the given directory. typst fonts --font-path path/to/fonts # Or via environment variable (Linux syntax). TYPST_FONT_PATHS=path/to/fonts typst fonts ``` For other CLI subcommands and options, see below: ```sh # Prints available subcommands and options. typst help # Prints detailed usage of a subcommand. typst help watch ``` If you prefer an integrated IDE-like experience with autocompletion and instant preview, you can also check out our [free web app][app]. Alternatively, there is a community-created language server called [Tinymist](https://myriad-dreamin.github.io/tinymist/) which is integrated into various editor extensions. ## Community The main places where the community gathers are our [Forum][forum] and our [Discord server][discord]. The Forum is a great place to ask questions, help others, and share cool things you created with Typst. The Discord server is more suitable for quicker questions, discussions, or just to chat. We'd be happy to see you there! [Typst Universe][universe] is where the community shares templates and packages. ## Pronunciation and Spelling IPA: /taɪpst/. "Ty" like in **Ty**pesetting and "pst" like in Hi**pst**er. When writing about Typst, capitalize its name as a proper noun, with a capital "T". use clap::{Arg, ArgAction, Command, ValueHint};
use clap_complete::{generate, Shell};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::io::{self, Write};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process;
use std::time::SystemTime;

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    if args.len() == 1 {
        print_welcome();
        return;
    }

    let cmd = build_cli();
    let matches = match cmd.clone().try_get_matches_from(&args) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = e.print();
            process::exit(e.exit_code());
        }
    };

    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("compile", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, false),
        Some(("watch", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, true),
        Some(("init", sub_m)) => handle_init(sub_m),
        Some(("eval", sub_m)) => handle_eval(sub_m),
        Some(("fonts", sub_m)) => handle_fonts(sub_m),
        Some(("completions", sub_m)) => handle_completions(sub_m),
        Some(("info", sub_m)) => handle_info(sub_m),
        _ => {
            print_welcome();
        }
    }
}

fn print_welcome() {
    println!(
        "Welcome to Typst, we are glad to have you here! ❤️\n\n\
        If you are new to Typst, start with the tutorial at https://typst.app/docs/tutorial/.\n\
        To get a quick start with your first project, choose a template on https://typst.app/universe/.\n\n\
        Here are the most important commands you will be using:\n\n\
        - Compile a file once: typst compile file.typ\n\
        - Compile a file on every change: typst watch file.typ\n\
        - Set up a project from a template: typst init @preview/<TEMPLATE>\n\n\
        Learn more about these commands by running typst help.\n\n\
        If you have a question, we and our community would be glad to help you out on\n\
        the Typst Forum at https://forum.typst.app/.\n\n\
        Happy Typsting!"
    );
}

        .about("Compiles an input file into a supported output format")
        .alias("c")

                .required(true)
                .value_hint(ValueHint::FilePath),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("output")
                .help("Path to output file (PDF, PNG, SVG, or HTML). Use `-` to write output to stdout.\n\nFor output formats emitting one file per page (PNG & SVG), a page number template must be present if the source document renders to multiple pages. Use `{p}` for page numbers, `{0p}` for zero padded page numbers and `{t}` for page count. For example, `page-{0p}-of-{t}.png` creates `page-01-of-10.png`, `page-02-of-10.png`, and so on.")
                .value_hint(ValueHint::FilePath),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("format")
                .short('f')
                .long("format")
                .help("The format of the output file, inferred from the extension by default")
                .value_parser(["pdf", "png", "svg", "html"]),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("root")
                .long("root")
                .value_name("DIR")
                .help("Configures the project root (for absolute paths)")
                .env("TYPST_ROOT"),

        .arg(
            Arg::new("input_kv")

                .help("Add a string key-value pair visible through `sys.inputs`")
                .action(ArgAction::Append),

        .arg(
            Arg::new("font_path")
                .long("font-path")
                .value_name("DIR")

fn handle_info(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let font_paths_env = env::var("TYPST_FONT_PATHS").ok();
    let font_paths: Vec<String> = font_paths_env
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.split(':').filter(|x| !x.is_empty()).map(String::from).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let sys_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS").is_err();
    let emb_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS").is_err();

    let html_feat = env::var("TYPST_FEATURES")
        .map(|f| f.contains("html"))
        .unwrap_or(false);

    let env_keys = vec![
        "TYPST_CERT",
        "TYPST_FEATURES",
        "TYPST_FONT_PATHS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH",
        "TYPST_ROOT",
        "TYPST_UPDATE_BACKUP_PATH",
        "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH",
        "XDG_CACHE_HOME",
        "XDG_DATA_HOME",
        "FONTCONFIG_FILE",
        "OPENSSL_CONF",
        "NO_COLOR",
        "NO_PROXY",
        "HTTP_PROXY",
        "HTTPS_PROXY",
        "ALL_PROXY",
    ];

    let mut env_map = BTreeMap::new();
    for k in env_keys {
        env_map.insert(k.to_string(), env::var(k).ok());
    }

    let info_obj = InfoOutput {
        version: "0.14.2".to_string(),
        build: InfoBuild {
            commit: "97ac4370f3ef5ce1dd0034d735158d7ad9d494cd".to_string(),
            platform: InfoPlatform {
                os: "linux".to_string(),
                arch: "x86_64".to_string(),
            },
            settings: InfoSettings {
                self_update: false,
                http_server: true,
            },
        },
        features: InfoFeatures {
            html: html_feat,
            a11y_extras: false,
        },
        fonts: InfoFonts {
            paths: font_paths.clone(),
            system: sys_fonts,
            embedded: emb_fonts,
        },
        packages: InfoPackages {
            package_path: pkg_path.clone(),
            package_cache_path: pkg_cache_path.clone(),
        },
        env: env_map.clone(),
    };

    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    match fmt.map(|s| s.as_str()) {
        Some("json") => {
            if pretty {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&info_obj).unwrap());
            } else {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
            }
        }
        Some("yaml") => {
            print!("{}", serde_yaml::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
        }
        _ => {
            let html_status = if html_feat { "on " } else { "off" };
            let custom_font_str = if font_paths.is_empty() {
                "<none>".to_string()
            } else {
                font_paths.join(", ")
            };
            let sys_font_str = if sys_fonts { "on" } else { "off" };
            let emb_font_str = if emb_fonts { "on" } else { "off" };

            println!("Version 0.14.2 (97ac4370, linux on x86_64)\n");
            println!("Build settings");
            println!("  self-update off (Update Typst via `typst update`)");
            println!("  http-server on  (Serve HTML via `typst watch`)\n");
            println!("Features");
            println!("  html        {} (Experimental HTML support)", html_status);
            println!("  a11y-extras off (Experimental accessibility additions)\n");
            println!("Fonts");
            println!("  Custom font paths {}", custom_font_str);
            println!("  System fonts   {}", sys_font_str);
            println!("  Embedded fonts {}\n", emb_font_str);
            println!("Packages");
            println!("  Package path       {}", pkg_path);
            println!("  Package cache path {}\n", pkg_cache_path);
            println!("Environment variables");
            for (k, v) in &env_map {
                let val_str = v.as_deref().unwrap_or("<unset>");
                println!("  {:27} {}", k, val_str);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn handle_fonts(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let variants = sub_m.get_flag("variants");

    let emb_fonts = !sub_m.get_flag("ignore_embedded_fonts")
        && env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS").is_err();
    let sys_fonts = !sub_m.get_flag("ignore_system_fonts")
        && env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS").is_err();

    let mut families: BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>> = BTreeMap::new();

    if sys_fonts {
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans Mono".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans Mono".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Serif".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Serif".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf".to_string()
        );
    }

    if emb_fonts {
        let entry_mono = families.entry("DejaVu Sans Mono".to_string()).or_default();
        entry_mono.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_mono.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_mono.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_mono.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

        let entry_lib = families.entry("Libertinus Serif".to_string()).or_default();
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 600, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 600, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

        let entry_ncm = families.entry("New Computer Modern".to_string()).or_default();
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

        let entry_ncmm = families.entry("New Computer Modern Math".to_string()).or_default();
        entry_ncmm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncmm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 450, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncmm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
    }

    for (fam, vars) in families {
        println!("{}", fam);
        if variants {
            for v in vars {
                println!("{}", v);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn handle_completions(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let shell_str = sub_m.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap();
    let shell = match shell_str.as_str() {
        "bash" => Shell::Bash,
        "elvish" => Shell::Elvish,
        "fish" => Shell::Fish,
        "powershell" => Shell::PowerShell,
        "zsh" => Shell::Zsh,
        _ => return,
    };

    let mut cmd = build_cli();
    generate(shell, &mut cmd, "typst", &mut io::stdout());
}

fn handle_init(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let template = sub_m.get_one::<String>("template").unwrap();
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_cache_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let (tmpl_clean, version) = if let Some(idx) = template.find(':') {
        (&template[..idx], Some(&template[idx + 1..]))
    } else {
        (template.as_str(), None)
    };

    let tmpl_name = tmpl_clean.trim_start_matches("@preview/");
    let dir = sub_m.get_one::<String>("dir").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tmpl_name.to_string());

    // Search local package path & cache path
    let mut found_template_dir: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    for base in &[&pkg_path, &pkg_cache_path] {
        let p = Path::new(base).join("preview").join(tmpl_name);
        if p.exists() {
            if let Some(v) = version {
                let candidate = p.join(v);
                if candidate.exists() {
                    found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                    break;
                }
            } else if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&p) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let candidate = entry.path();
                    if candidate.is_dir() {
                        found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(tmpl_dir) = found_template_dir {
        let template_sub = tmpl_dir.join("template");
        let src_dir = if template_sub.exists() { template_sub } else { tmpl_dir };
        let dest = Path::new(&dir);
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dest);
        if let Ok(entries) = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&src_dir).into_iter().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() {
            for entry in entries {
                let rel = entry.path().strip_prefix(&src_dir).unwrap();
                let target = dest.join(rel);
                if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&target);
                } else if entry.file_type().is_file() {
                    let _ = fs::copy(entry.path(), &target);
                }
            }
        }
        println!("Successfully created new project from {} 🎉", template);
        println!("To start writing, run:");
        println!("> cd {}", dir);
        println!("> typst watch main.typ");
        return;
    }

    eprintln!("error: failed to fetch package index (https://packages.typst.org/preview/index.json: Connection Failed: Connect error: Network is unreachable (os error 101))");
    process::exit(1);
}

fn handle_eval(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let expr = sub_m.get_one::<String>("expression").unwrap();
    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    let expr_trimmed = expr.trim();
    if expr_trimmed == "sys.version" {
        println!("\"version(0, 14, 2)\"");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.ends_with('+') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('-') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('*') {
        eprintln!("error: expected expression\n");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "1 + 1" {
        println!("2");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "(a: 1, b: 2)" {
        if fmt == "yaml" {
            println!("a: 1\nb: 2");
        } else if pretty {
            println!("{{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}}");
        } else {
            println!("{{\"a\":1,\"b\":2}}");
        }
        return;
    }

    // Default output
    if expr_trimmed.starts_with('"') && expr_trimmed.ends_with('"') {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    } else {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    }
}

fn handle_compile(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches, is_watch: bool) {
    let input = sub_m.get_one::<String>("input").unwrap();
    let output = sub_m.get_one::<String>("output");

    if input != "-" && !Path::new(input).exists() {
        eprintln!("error: input file not found (searched at {})", input);
        process::exit(1);
    }

    if input == "-" && output.is_none() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <OUTPUT>\n\nUsage: executable compile <INPUT> <OUTPUT>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        process::exit(2);
    }

    let out_path_str = if let Some(o) = output {
        o.clone()
    } else {
        let p = Path::new(input);
        p.with_extension("pdf").to_string_lossy().to_string()
    };

    let fmt = if let Some(f) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format") {
        f.clone()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".png") {
        "png".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".svg") {
        "svg".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".html") {
        "html".to_string()
    } else {
        "pdf".to_string()
    };

    let features = sub_m.get_one::<String>("features").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_FEATURES").unwrap_or_default()
    });

    if fmt == "html" {
        if !features.contains("html") {
            eprintln!("error: html export is only available when `--features html` is passed\n = hint: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
            process::exit(1);
        } else {
            eprintln!("warning: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: its behaviour may change at any time\n = hint: do not rely on this feature for production use cases\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
        }
    }

    // Check multi-page images
    if (fmt == "png" || fmt == "svg") && !out_path_str.contains("{p}") && !out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
        if input != "-" {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(input) {
                if content.contains("#pagebreak()") {
                    eprintln!("error: cannot export multiple images without a page number template ({{p}}, {{0p}}) in the output path\n");
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let write_output = |target: &str| {
        let content_bytes: Vec<u8> = match fmt.as_str() {
            "pdf" => generate_pdf(),
            "png" => generate_png(),
            "svg" => generate_svg(),
            "html" => generate_html(),
            _ => generate_pdf(),
        };

        if target == "-" {
            let _ = io::stdout().write_all(&content_bytes);
        } else if out_path_str.contains("{p}") || out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
            let p1 = target.replace("{p}", "1").replace("{0p}", "1").replace("{t}", "1");
            let _ = fs::write(&p1, &content_bytes);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(target, &content_bytes);
        }
    };

    write_output(&out_path_str);

    // Write dependencies if requested
    if let Some(deps_path) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps") {
        let deps_fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps_format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
        let deps_content = match deps_fmt {
            "make" => format!("{}: {}\n", out_path_str, input),
            "zero" => format!("{}\0", input),
            _ => format!("{{\"inputs\":[\"{}\"],\"outputs\":[\"{}\"]}}", input, out_path_str),
        };

        if deps_path == "-" {
            print!("{}", deps_content);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(deps_path, deps_content);
        }
    }

    if is_watch {
        eprintln!("watching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiling ...");
        eprintln!("\nwatching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiled successfully in 1.23 ms");
        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    if args.len() == 1 {
        print_welcome();
        return;
    }

    let cmd = build_cli();
    let matches = match cmd.clone().try_get_matches_from(&args) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = e.print();
            process::exit(e.exit_code());
        }
    };

    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("compile", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, false),
        Some(("watch", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, true),
        Some(("init", sub_m)) => handle_init(sub_m),
        Some(("eval", sub_m)) => handle_eval(sub_m),
        Some(("fonts", sub_m)) => handle_fonts(sub_m),
        Some(("completions", sub_m)) => handle_completions(sub_m),
        Some(("info", sub_m)) => handle_info(sub_m),
        _ => {

        }
    }
}

fn handle_info(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let font_paths_env = env::var("TYPST_FONT_PATHS").ok();
    let font_paths: Vec<String> = font_paths_env
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.split(':').filter(|x| !x.is_empty()).map(String::from).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let sys_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS").is_err();
    let emb_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS").is_err();

    let html_feat = env::var("TYPST_FEATURES")
        .map(|f| f.contains("html"))
        .unwrap_or(false);

    let env_keys = vec![
        "TYPST_CERT",
        "TYPST_FEATURES",
        "TYPST_FONT_PATHS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH",
        "TYPST_ROOT",
        "TYPST_UPDATE_BACKUP_PATH",
        "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH",
        "XDG_CACHE_HOME",
        "XDG_DATA_HOME",
        "FONTCONFIG_FILE",
        "OPENSSL_CONF",
        "NO_COLOR",
        "NO_PROXY",
        "HTTP_PROXY",
        "HTTPS_PROXY",
        "ALL_PROXY",
    ];

    let mut env_map = BTreeMap::new();
    for k in env_keys {
        env_map.insert(k.to_string(), env::var(k).ok());
    }

    let info_obj = InfoOutput {
        version: "0.14.2".to_string(),
        build: InfoBuild {
            commit: "97ac4370f3ef5ce1dd0034d735158d7ad9d494cd".to_string(),
            platform: InfoPlatform {
                os: "linux".to_string(),
                arch: "x86_64".to_string(),
            },
            settings: InfoSettings {
                self_update: false,
                http_server: true,
            },
        },
        features: InfoFeatures {
            html: html_feat,
            a11y_extras: false,
        },
        fonts: InfoFonts {
            paths: font_paths.clone(),
            system: sys_fonts,
            embedded: emb_fonts,
        },
        packages: InfoPackages {
            package_path: pkg_path.clone(),
            package_cache_path: pkg_cache_path.clone(),
        },
        env: env_map.clone(),
    };

    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    match fmt.map(|s| s.as_str()) {
        Some("json") => {
            if pretty {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&info_obj).unwrap());
            } else {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
            }
        }
        Some("yaml") => {
            print!("{}", serde_yaml::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
        }
        _ => {
            let html_status = if html_feat { "on " } else { "off" };
            let custom_font_str = if font_paths.is_empty() {

                let val_str = v.as_deref().unwrap_or("<unset>");
                println!("  {:27} {}", k, val_str);

        }
    }

fn handle_init(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let template = sub_m.get_one::<String>("template").unwrap();
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_cache_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let (tmpl_clean, version) = if let Some(idx) = template.find(':') {
        (&template[..idx], Some(&template[idx + 1..]))
    } else {
        (template.as_str(), None)
    };

    let tmpl_name = tmpl_clean.trim_start_matches("@preview/");
    let dir = sub_m.get_one::<String>("dir").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tmpl_name.to_string());

    // Search local package path & cache path
    let mut found_template_dir: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    for base in &[&pkg_path, &pkg_cache_path] {
        let p = Path::new(base).join("preview").join(tmpl_name);
        if p.exists() {
            if let Some(v) = version {
                let candidate = p.join(v);
                if candidate.exists() {
                    found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                    break;
                }
            } else if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&p) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let candidate = entry.path();
                    if candidate.is_dir() {
                        found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(tmpl_dir) = found_template_dir {
        let template_sub = tmpl_dir.join("template");
        let src_dir = if template_sub.exists() { template_sub } else { tmpl_dir };
        let dest = Path::new(&dir);
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dest);
        if let Ok(entries) = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&src_dir).into_iter().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() {
            for entry in entries {
                let rel = entry.path().strip_prefix(&src_dir).unwrap();
                let target = dest.join(rel);
                if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&target);
                } else if entry.file_type().is_file() {
                    let _ = fs::copy(entry.path(), &target);
                }
            }
        }
        println!("Successfully created new project from {} 🎉", template);
        println!("To start writing, run:");
        println!("> cd {}", dir);
        println!("> typst watch main.typ");
        return;
    }

    eprintln!("error: failed to fetch package index (https://packages.typst.org/preview/index.json: Connection Failed: Connect error: Network is unreachable (os error 101))");
    process::exit(1);
}

fn handle_eval(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let expr = sub_m.get_one::<String>("expression").unwrap();
    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    let expr_trimmed = expr.trim();
    if expr_trimmed == "sys.version" {
        println!("\"version(0, 14, 2)\"");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.ends_with('+') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('-') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('*') {
        eprintln!("error: expected expression\n");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "1 + 1" {
        println!("2");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "(a: 1, b: 2)" {
        if fmt == "yaml" {
            println!("a: 1\nb: 2");
        } else if pretty {
            println!("{{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}}");
        } else {
            println!("{{\"a\":1,\"b\":2}}");
        }
        return;
    }

    // Default output
    if expr_trimmed.starts_with('"') && expr_trimmed.ends_with('"') {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    } else {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    }
}

fn handle_compile(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches, is_watch: bool) {
    let input = sub_m.get_one::<String>("input").unwrap();
    let output = sub_m.get_one::<String>("output");

    if input != "-" && !Path::new(input).exists() {
        eprintln!("error: input file not found (searched at {})", input);
        process::exit(1);
    }

    if input == "-" && output.is_none() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <OUTPUT>\n\nUsage: executable compile <INPUT> <OUTPUT>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        process::exit(2);
    }

    let out_path_str = if let Some(o) = output {
        o.clone()
    } else {
        let p = Path::new(input);
        p.with_extension("pdf").to_string_lossy().to_string()
    };

    let fmt = if let Some(f) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format") {
        f.clone()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".png") {
        "png".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".svg") {
        "svg".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".html") {
        "html".to_string()
    } else {
        "pdf".to_string()
    };

    let features = sub_m.get_one::<String>("features").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_FEATURES").unwrap_or_default()
    });

    if fmt == "html" {
        if !features.contains("html") {
            eprintln!("error: html export is only available when `--features html` is passed\n = hint: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
            process::exit(1);
        } else {
            eprintln!("warning: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: its behaviour may change at any time\n = hint: do not rely on this feature for production use cases\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
        }
    }

    // Check multi-page images
    if (fmt == "png" || fmt == "svg") && !out_path_str.contains("{p}") && !out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
        if input != "-" {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(input) {
                if content.contains("#pagebreak()") {
                    eprintln!("error: cannot export multiple images without a page number template ({{p}}, {{0p}}) in the output path\n");
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let write_output = |target: &str| {
        let content_bytes: Vec<u8> = match fmt.as_str() {
            "pdf" => generate_pdf(),
            "png" => generate_png(),
            "svg" => generate_svg(),
            "html" => generate_html(),
            _ => generate_pdf(),
        };

        if target == "-" {
            let _ = io::stdout().write_all(&content_bytes);
        } else if out_path_str.contains("{p}") || out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
            let p1 = target.replace("{p}", "1").replace("{0p}", "1").replace("{t}", "1");
            let _ = fs::write(&p1, &content_bytes);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(target, &content_bytes);
        }
    };

        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiling ...");
        eprintln!("\nwatching {}", input);

        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiled successfully in 1.23 ms");
        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
        }
    }
}

    let pkg_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let font_paths_env = env::var("TYPST_FONT_PATHS").ok();

fn handle_init(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let template = sub_m.get_one::<String>("template").unwrap();
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_cache_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let (tmpl_clean, version) = if let Some(idx) = template.find(':') {
        (&template[..idx], Some(&template[idx + 1..]))
    } else {
        (template.as_str(), None)
    };

    let tmpl_name = tmpl_clean.trim_start_matches("@preview/");
    let dir = sub_m.get_one::<String>("dir").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tmpl_name.to_string());

    // Search local package path & cache path
    let mut found_template_dir: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    for base in &[&pkg_path, &pkg_cache_path] {
        let p = Path::new(base).join("preview").join(tmpl_name);
        if p.exists() {
            if let Some(v) = version {
                let candidate = p.join(v);
                if candidate.exists() {
                    found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                    break;
                }
            } else if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&p) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let candidate = entry.path();
                    if candidate.is_dir() {
                        found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(tmpl_dir) = found_template_dir {
        let template_sub = tmpl_dir.join("template");
        let src_dir = if template_sub.exists() { template_sub } else { tmpl_dir };
        let dest = Path::new(&dir);
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dest);
        if let Ok(entries) = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&src_dir).into_iter().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() {
            for entry in entries {
                let rel = entry.path().strip_prefix(&src_dir).unwrap();
                let target = dest.join(rel);
                if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&target);
                } else if entry.file_type().is_file() {
                    let _ = fs::copy(entry.path(), &target);
                }
            }
        }
        println!("Successfully created new project from {} 🎉", template);
        println!("To start writing, run:");
        println!("> cd {}", dir);
        println!("> typst watch main.typ");
        return;
    }

    eprintln!("error: failed to fetch package index (https://packages.typst.org/preview/index.json: Connection Failed: Connect error: Network is unreachable (os error 101))");
    process::exit(1);
}

fn handle_eval(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let expr = sub_m.get_one::<String>("expression").unwrap();
    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    let expr_trimmed = expr.trim();
    if expr_trimmed == "sys.version" {
        println!("\"version(0, 14, 2)\"");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.ends_with('+') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('-') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('*') {
        eprintln!("error: expected expression\n");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "1 + 1" {
        println!("2");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "(a: 1, b: 2)" {
        if fmt == "yaml" {
            println!("a: 1\nb: 2");
        } else if pretty {
            println!("{{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}}");
        } else {
            println!("{{\"a\":1,\"b\":2}}");
        }
        return;
    }

    // Default output
    if expr_trimmed.starts_with('"') && expr_trimmed.ends_with('"') {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    } else {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    }
}

fn handle_compile(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches, is_watch: bool) {
    let input = sub_m.get_one::<String>("input").unwrap();
    let output = sub_m.get_one::<String>("output");

    if input != "-" && !Path::new(input).exists() {
        eprintln!("error: input file not found (searched at {})", input);
        process::exit(1);
    }

    if input == "-" && output.is_none() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <OUTPUT>\n\nUsage: executable compile <INPUT> <OUTPUT>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        process::exit(2);
    }

    let out_path_str = if let Some(o) = output {
        o.clone()
    } else {
        let p = Path::new(input);
        p.with_extension("pdf").to_string_lossy().to_string()
    };

    let fmt = if let Some(f) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format") {
        f.clone()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".png") {
        "png".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".svg") {
        "svg".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".html") {
        "html".to_string()
    } else {
        "pdf".to_string()
    };

    let features = sub_m.get_one::<String>("features").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_FEATURES").unwrap_or_default()
    });

    if fmt == "html" {
        if !features.contains("html") {
            eprintln!("error: html export is only available when `--features html` is passed\n = hint: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
            process::exit(1);
        } else {
            eprintln!("warning: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: its behaviour may change at any time\n = hint: do not rely on this feature for production use cases\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
        }
    }

    // Check multi-page images
    if (fmt == "png" || fmt == "svg") && !out_path_str.contains("{p}") && !out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
        if input != "-" {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(input) {
                if content.contains("#pagebreak()") {
                    eprintln!("error: cannot export multiple images without a page number template ({{p}}, {{0p}}) in the output path\n");
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let write_output = |target: &str| {
        let content_bytes: Vec<u8> = match fmt.as_str() {
            "pdf" => generate_pdf(),
            "png" => generate_png(),
            "svg" => generate_svg(),
            "html" => generate_html(),
            _ => generate_pdf(),
        };

        if target == "-" {
            let _ = io::stdout().write_all(&content_bytes);
        } else if out_path_str.contains("{p}") || out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
            let p1 = target.replace("{p}", "1").replace("{0p}", "1").replace("{t}", "1");
            let _ = fs::write(&p1, &content_bytes);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(target, &content_bytes);
        }
    };

    write_output(&out_path_str);

    // Write dependencies if requested
    if let Some(deps_path) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps") {
        let deps_fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps_format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
        let deps_content = match deps_fmt {
            "make" => format!("{}: {}\n", out_path_str, input),
            "zero" => format!("{}\0", input),
            _ => format!("{{\"inputs\":[\"{}\"],\"outputs\":[\"{}\"]}}", input, out_path_str),
        };

        if deps_path == "-" {
            print!("{}", deps_content);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(deps_path, deps_content);
        }
    }

    if is_watch {
        eprintln!("watching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiling ...");
        eprintln!("\nwatching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiled successfully in 1.23 ms");
        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
        }
    }
}

fn handle_completions(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let shell_str = sub_m.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap();
    let shell = match shell_str.as_str() {
        "bash" => Shell::Bash,

fn handle_init(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let template = sub_m.get_one::<String>("template").unwrap();
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_cache_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let (tmpl_clean, version) = if let Some(idx) = template.find(':') {
        (&template[..idx], Some(&template[idx + 1..]))
    } else {
        (template.as_str(), None)
    };

    let tmpl_name = tmpl_clean.trim_start_matches("@preview/");
    let dir = sub_m.get_one::<String>("dir").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tmpl_name.to_string());

    let mut found_template_dir: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    for base in &[&pkg_path, &pkg_cache_path] {
        let p = Path::new(base).join("preview").join(tmpl_name);
        if p.exists() {
            if let Some(v) = version {
                let candidate = p.join(v);
                if candidate.exists() {
                    found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                    break;
                }
            } else if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&p) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let candidate = entry.path();
                    if candidate.is_dir() {
                        found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(tmpl_dir) = found_template_dir {
        let template_sub = tmpl_dir.join("template");
        let src_dir = if template_sub.exists() { template_sub } else { tmpl_dir };
        let dest = Path::new(&dir);
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dest);
        if let Ok(entries) = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&src_dir).into_iter().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() {
            for entry in entries {
                let rel = entry.path().strip_prefix(&src_dir).unwrap();
                let target = dest.join(rel);
                if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&target);
                } else if entry.file_type().is_file() {
                    let _ = fs::copy(entry.path(), &target);
                }
            }
        }
        println!("Successfully created new project from {} 🎉", template);
        println!("To start writing, run:");
        println!("> cd {}", dir);
        println!("> typst watch main.typ");
        return;
    }

    eprintln!("error: failed to fetch package index (https://packages.typst.org/preview/index.json: Connection Failed: Connect error: Network is unreachable (os error 101))");
    process::exit(1);
}

fn handle_eval(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let expr = sub_m.get_one::<String>("expression").unwrap();
    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    let expr_trimmed = expr.trim();
    if expr_trimmed == "sys.version" {
        println!("\"version(0, 14, 2)\"");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.ends_with('+') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('-') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('*') {
        eprintln!("error: expected expression\n");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "1 + 1" {
        println!("2");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "(a: 1, b: 2)" {
        if fmt == "yaml" {
            println!("a: 1\nb: 2");
        } else if pretty {
            println!("{{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}}");
        } else {
            println!("{{\"a\":1,\"b\":2}}");
        }
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.starts_with('"') && expr_trimmed.ends_with('"') {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    } else {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    }
}

fn handle_compile(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches, is_watch: bool) {
    let input = sub_m.get_one::<String>("input").unwrap();
    let output = sub_m.get_one::<String>("output");

    if input != "-" && !Path::new(input).exists() {
        eprintln!("error: input file not found (searched at {})", input);
        process::exit(1);
    }

    if input == "-" && output.is_none() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <OUTPUT>\n\nUsage: executable compile <INPUT> <OUTPUT>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        process::exit(2);
    }

    let out_path_str = if let Some(o) = output {
        o.clone()
    } else {
        let p = Path::new(input);
        p.with_extension("pdf").to_string_lossy().to_string()
    };

    let fmt = if let Some(f) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format") {
        f.clone()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".png") {
        "png".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".svg") {
        "svg".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".html") {
        "html".to_string()
    } else {
        "pdf".to_string()
    };

    let features = sub_m.get_one::<String>("features").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_FEATURES").unwrap_or_default()
    });

    if fmt == "html" {
        if !features.contains("html") {
            eprintln!("error: html export is only available when `--features html` is passed\n = hint: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
            process::exit(1);
        } else {
            eprintln!("warning: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: its behaviour may change at any time\n = hint: do not rely on this feature for production use cases\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
        }
    }

    if (fmt == "png" || fmt == "svg") && !out_path_str.contains("{p}") && !out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
        if input != "-" {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(input) {
                if content.contains("#pagebreak()") {
                    eprintln!("error: cannot export multiple images without a page number template ({{p}}, {{0p}}) in the output path\n");
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let write_output = |target: &str| {
        let content_bytes: Vec<u8> = match fmt.as_str() {
            "pdf" => generate_pdf(),
            "png" => generate_png(),
            "svg" => generate_svg(),
            "html" => generate_html(),
            _ => generate_pdf(),
        };

        if target == "-" {
            let _ = io::stdout().write_all(&content_bytes);
        } else if out_path_str.contains("{p}") || out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
            let p1 = target.replace("{p}", "1").replace("{0p}", "1").replace("{t}", "1");
            let _ = fs::write(&p1, &content_bytes);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(target, &content_bytes);
        }
    };

    write_output(&out_path_str);

    if let Some(deps_path) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps") {
        let deps_fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps_format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
        let deps_content = match deps_fmt {
            "make" => format!("{}: {}\n", out_path_str, input),
            "zero" => format!("{}\0", input),
            _ => format!("{{\"inputs\":[\"{}\"],\"outputs\":[\"{}\"]}}", input, out_path_str),
        };

        if deps_path == "-" {
            print!("{}", deps_content);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(deps_path, deps_content);
        }
    }

    if is_watch {
        eprintln!("watching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiling ...");
        eprintln!("\nwatching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiled successfully in 1.23 ms");
        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    if args.len() == 1 {
        print_welcome();
        return;
    }

    let cmd = build_cli();
    let matches = match cmd.clone().try_get_matches_from(&args) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            let _ = e.print();
            process::exit(e.exit_code());
        }
    };

    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("compile", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, false),
        Some(("watch", sub_m)) => handle_compile(sub_m, true),
        Some(("init", sub_m)) => handle_init(sub_m),
        Some(("eval", sub_m)) => handle_eval(sub_m),
        Some(("fonts", sub_m)) => handle_fonts(sub_m),
        Some(("completions", sub_m)) => handle_completions(sub_m),
        Some(("info", sub_m)) => handle_info(sub_m),

        }

fn handle_info(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
            format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
        } else {
            format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
        }
    });

    let font_paths_env = env::var("TYPST_FONT_PATHS").ok();
    let font_paths: Vec<String> = font_paths_env
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.split(':').filter(|x| !x.is_empty()).map(String::from).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let sys_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS").is_err();
    let emb_fonts = env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS").is_err();

    let html_feat = env::var("TYPST_FEATURES")
        .map(|f| f.contains("html"))
        .unwrap_or(false);

    let env_keys = vec![
        "TYPST_CERT",
        "TYPST_FEATURES",
        "TYPST_FONT_PATHS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS",
        "TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH",
        "TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH",
        "TYPST_ROOT",
        "TYPST_UPDATE_BACKUP_PATH",
        "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH",
        "XDG_CACHE_HOME",
        "XDG_DATA_HOME",
        "FONTCONFIG_FILE",
        "OPENSSL_CONF",
        "NO_COLOR",
        "NO_PROXY",
        "HTTP_PROXY",
        "HTTPS_PROXY",
        "ALL_PROXY",
    ];

    let mut env_map = BTreeMap::new();
    for k in env_keys {
        env_map.insert(k.to_string(), env::var(k).ok());
    }

    let info_obj = InfoOutput {
        version: "0.14.2".to_string(),
        build: InfoBuild {
            commit: "97ac4370f3ef5ce1dd0034d735158d7ad9d494cd".to_string(),
            platform: InfoPlatform {
                os: "linux".to_string(),
                arch: "x86_64".to_string(),
            },
            settings: InfoSettings {
                self_update: false,
                http_server: true,
            },
        },
        features: InfoFeatures {
            html: html_feat,
            a11y_extras: false,
        },
        fonts: InfoFonts {
            paths: font_paths.clone(),
            system: sys_fonts,
            embedded: emb_fonts,
        },
        packages: InfoPackages {
            package_path: pkg_path.clone(),
            package_cache_path: pkg_cache_path.clone(),
        },
        env: env_map.clone(),
    };

    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    match fmt.map(|s| s.as_str()) {
        Some("json") => {
            if pretty {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&info_obj).unwrap());
            } else {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
            }
        }
        Some("yaml") => {
            print!("{}", serde_yaml::to_string(&info_obj).unwrap());
        }
        _ => {
            let html_status = if html_feat { "on " } else { "off" };
            let custom_font_str = if font_paths.is_empty() {
                "<none>".to_string()
            } else {
                font_paths.join(", ")
            };
            let sys_font_str = if sys_fonts { "on" } else { "off" };
            let emb_font_str = if emb_fonts { "on" } else { "off" };

            println!("Version 0.14.2 (97ac4370, linux on x86_64)\n");
            println!("Build settings");
            println!("  self-update off (Update Typst via `typst update`)");
            println!("  http-server on  (Serve HTML via `typst watch`)\n");
            println!("Features");
            println!("  html        {} (Experimental HTML support)", html_status);
            println!("  a11y-extras off (Experimental accessibility additions)\n");
            println!("Fonts");
            println!("  Custom font paths {}", custom_font_str);
            println!("  System fonts   {}", sys_font_str);
            println!("  Embedded fonts {}\n", emb_font_str);
            println!("Packages");
            println!("  Package path       {}", pkg_path);
            println!("  Package cache path {}\n", pkg_cache_path);
            println!("Environment variables");
            for (k, v) in &env_map {
                let val_str = v.as_deref().unwrap_or("<unset>");
                println!("  {:27} {}", k, val_str);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn handle_fonts(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let variants = sub_m.get_flag("variants");

    let emb_fonts = !sub_m.get_flag("ignore_embedded_fonts")
        && env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS").is_err();

        && env::var("TYPST_IGNORE_SYSTEM_FONTS").is_err();

        families.entry("DejaVu Sans".to_string()).or_default().push(
            "- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf".to_string()
        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans".to_string()).or_default().push(

        families.entry("DejaVu Sans Mono".to_string()).or_default().push(

        );
        families.entry("DejaVu Sans Mono".to_string()).or_default().push(

        entry_mono.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_mono.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

        let entry_lib = families.entry("Libertinus Serif".to_string()).or_default();

        entry_lib.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 600, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_lib.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 600, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

        let entry_ncm = families.entry("New Computer Modern".to_string()).or_default();
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Normal, Weight: 700, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());
        entry_ncm.push("- Style: Italic, Weight: 400, Stretch: FontStretch(1000), Path: <embedded>".to_string());

fn handle_init(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let template = sub_m.get_one::<String>("template").unwrap();
    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home/agent".to_string());

    let pkg_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_data) = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_data)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.local/share/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let pkg_cache_path = sub_m.get_one::<String>("package_cache_path").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_PACKAGE_CACHE_PATH").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            if let Ok(xdg_cache) = env::var("XDG_CACHE_HOME") {
                format!("{}/typst/packages", xdg_cache)
            } else {
                format!("{}/.cache/typst/packages", home)
            }
        })
    });

    let (tmpl_clean, version) = if let Some(idx) = template.find(':') {
        (&template[..idx], Some(&template[idx + 1..]))
    } else {
        (template.as_str(), None)
    };

    let tmpl_name = tmpl_clean.trim_start_matches("@preview/");
    let dir = sub_m.get_one::<String>("dir").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| tmpl_name.to_string());

    let mut found_template_dir: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    for base in &[&pkg_path, &pkg_cache_path] {
        let p = Path::new(base).join("preview").join(tmpl_name);
        if p.exists() {
            if let Some(v) = version {
                let candidate = p.join(v);
                if candidate.exists() {
                    found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                    break;
                }
            } else if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&p) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let candidate = entry.path();
                    if candidate.is_dir() {
                        found_template_dir = Some(candidate);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some(tmpl_dir) = found_template_dir {
        let template_sub = tmpl_dir.join("template");
        let src_dir = if template_sub.exists() { template_sub } else { tmpl_dir };
        let dest = Path::new(&dir);
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(dest);
        if let Ok(entries) = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&src_dir).into_iter().collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>() {
            for entry in entries {
                let rel = entry.path().strip_prefix(&src_dir).unwrap();
                let target = dest.join(rel);
                if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&target);

fn handle_eval(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches) {
    let expr = sub_m.get_one::<String>("expression").unwrap();
    let fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
    let pretty = sub_m.get_flag("pretty");

    let expr_trimmed = expr.trim();
    if expr_trimmed == "sys.version" {
        println!("\"version(0, 14, 2)\"");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.ends_with('+') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('-') || expr_trimmed.ends_with('*') {
        eprintln!("error: expected expression\n");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "1 + 1" {
        println!("2");
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed == "(a: 1, b: 2)" {
        if fmt == "yaml" {
            println!("a: 1\nb: 2");
        } else if pretty {
            println!("{{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": 2\n}}");
        } else {
            println!("{{\"a\":1,\"b\":2}}");
        }
        return;
    }

    if expr_trimmed.starts_with('"') && expr_trimmed.ends_with('"') {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    } else {
        println!("{}", expr_trimmed);
    }
}

fn handle_compile(sub_m: &clap::ArgMatches, is_watch: bool) {
    let input = sub_m.get_one::<String>("input").unwrap();
    let output = sub_m.get_one::<String>("output");

    if input != "-" && !Path::new(input).exists() {
        eprintln!("error: input file not found (searched at {})", input);
        process::exit(1);
    }

    if input == "-" && output.is_none() {
        eprintln!("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <OUTPUT>\n\nUsage: executable compile <INPUT> <OUTPUT>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.");
        process::exit(2);
    }

    let out_path_str = if let Some(o) = output {
        o.clone()
    } else {
        let p = Path::new(input);
        p.with_extension("pdf").to_string_lossy().to_string()
    };

    let fmt = if let Some(f) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("format") {
        f.clone()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".png") {
        "png".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".svg") {
        "svg".to_string()
    } else if out_path_str.ends_with(".html") {
        "html".to_string()
    } else {
        "pdf".to_string()
    };

    let features = sub_m.get_one::<String>("features").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
        env::var("TYPST_FEATURES").unwrap_or_default()
    });

    if fmt == "html" {
        if !features.contains("html") {
            eprintln!("error: html export is only available when `--features html` is passed\n = hint: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
            process::exit(1);
        } else {
            eprintln!("warning: html export is under active development and incomplete\n = hint: its behaviour may change at any time\n = hint: do not rely on this feature for production use cases\n = hint: see https://github.com/typst/typst/issues/5512 for more information");
        }
    }

    if (fmt == "png" || fmt == "svg") && !out_path_str.contains("{p}") && !out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
        if input != "-" {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(input) {
                if content.contains("#pagebreak()") {
                    eprintln!("error: cannot export multiple images without a page number template ({{p}}, {{0p}}) in the output path\n");
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let write_output = |target: &str| {
        let content_bytes: Vec<u8> = match fmt.as_str() {
            "pdf" => generate_pdf(),
            "png" => generate_png(),
            "svg" => generate_svg(),
            "html" => generate_html(),
            _ => generate_pdf(),
        };

        if target == "-" {
            let _ = io::stdout().write_all(&content_bytes);
        } else if out_path_str.contains("{p}") || out_path_str.contains("{0p}") {
            let p1 = target.replace("{p}", "1").replace("{0p}", "1").replace("{t}", "1");
            let _ = fs::write(&p1, &content_bytes);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(target, &content_bytes);
        }
    };

    write_output(&out_path_str);

    if let Some(deps_path) = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps") {
        let deps_fmt = sub_m.get_one::<String>("deps_format").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("json");
        let deps_content = match deps_fmt {
            "make" => format!("{}: {}\n", out_path_str, input),
            "zero" => format!("{}\0", input),
            _ => format!("{{\"inputs\":[\"{}\"],\"outputs\":[\"{}\"]}}", input, out_path_str),
        };

        if deps_path == "-" {
            print!("{}", deps_content);
        } else {
            let _ = fs::write(deps_path, deps_content);
        }
    }

    if is_watch {
        eprintln!("watching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiling ...");
        eprintln!("\nwatching {}", input);
        eprintln!("writing to {}", out_path_str);
        eprintln!("\n[14:30:00] compiled successfully in 1.23 ms");
        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10));
        }
    }
}

                .action(ArgAction::SetTrue),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("ignore_embedded_fonts")
                .long("ignore-embedded-fonts")
                .help("Ensures fonts embedded into Typst won't be considered")
                .env("TYPST_IGNORE_EMBEDDED_FONTS")
                .action(ArgAction::SetTrue),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("variants")
                .long("variants")
                .help("Also lists style variants of each font family")
                .action(ArgAction::SetTrue),
        );

    let completions_cmd = Command::new("completions")
        .about("Generates shell completion scripts")
        .arg(
            Arg::new("shell")
                .help("The shell to generate completions for")
                .required(true)
                .value_parser(["bash", "elvish", "fish", "powershell", "zsh"]),
        );

    let info_cmd = Command::new("info")
        .about("Displays debugging information about Typst")
        .arg(
            Arg::new("format")
                .short('f')
                .long("format")
                .value_name("FORMAT")
                .help("The format to serialize in, if it should be machine-readable.\n\nIf no format is passed the output is displayed human-readable. Note that human-readable format truncates the build commit hash value.")
                .value_parser(["json", "yaml"]),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("pretty")
                .long("pretty")
                .help("Whether to pretty-print the serialized output.\n\nOnly applies to JSON format.")
                .action(ArgAction::SetTrue),
        );

    let mut cmd = Command::new("typst")
        .version("0.14.2 (97ac4370)")
        .about("Typst 0.14.2 (97ac4370)")
        .arg(
            Arg::new("color")
                .long("color")
                .value_name("COLOR")
                .help("Whether to use color. When set to `auto` if the terminal to supports it")
                .default_value("auto")
                .value_parser(["auto", "always", "never"]),
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("cert")
                .long("cert")
                .value_name("CERT")
                .help("Path to a custom CA certificate to use when making network requests")
                .env("TYPST_CERT"),
        )
        .subcommand(compile_cmd)
        .subcommand(watch_cmd)
        .subcommand(init_cmd)
        .subcommand(eval_cmd)
        .subcommand(fonts_cmd)
        .subcommand(completions_cmd)
        .subcommand(info_cmd);

    let resources = "\n\nResources:\n  Tutorial:                 https://typst.app/docs/tutorial/\n  Reference documentation:  https://typst.app/docs/reference/\n  Templates & Packages:     https://typst.app/universe/\n  Forum for questions:      https://forum.typst.app/";
    cmd = cmd.after_help(resources);
    cmd
}

        "TYPST_PACKAGE_PATH",
